RULE-1.gloss: If a person p has rate r and regular hours h and CalcProduct(r, h, q), then RegularEarnings(p, q)
RULE-1.formula: ∀p∀r∀h∀q((Rate(p, r) ∧ RegularHours(p, h) ∧ CalcProduct(r, h, q)) → RegularEarnings(p, q))

RULE-2.gloss: If a person p has rate r and overtime hours oh and CalcProduct(r, oh, t) and OvertimeRatio(p, ratio) and CalcProduct(t, ratio, q), then OvertimePay(p, q)
RULE-2.formula: ∀p∀r∀oh∀t∀q∀ratio((Rate(p, r) ∧ OvertimeHours(p, oh) ∧ CalcProduct(r, oh, t) ∧ OvertimeRatio(p, ratio) ∧ CalcProduct(t, ratio, q)) → OvertimePay(p, q))

RULE-3.gloss: If RegularEarnings(p, e1) and OvertimePay(p, e2) and CalcSum(e1, e2, t), then TotalEarnings(p, t)
RULE-3.formula: ∀p∀e1∀e2∀t((RegularEarnings(p, e1) ∧ OvertimePay(p, e2) ∧ CalcSum(e1, e2, t)) → TotalEarnings(p, t))

RULE-4.gloss: If CalcDifference(a, b, c) and TotalHours(p, a) and RegularHours(p, b), then OvertimeHours(p, c)
RULE-4.formula: ∀p∀a∀b∀c((CalcDifference(a, b, c) ∧ TotalHours(p, a) ∧ RegularHours(p, b)) → OvertimeHours(p, c))
